pains.text: For the CTO/VP Eng whose buyer is the enterprise organization, the maintenance of compliance frameworks like GDPR and ISO 27001 alongside SOC 2 creates continuous overhead, because engineers must manually gather and map continuous evidence across cloud, GitHub, and Okta infrastructure rather than focusing on core service operations.

For the CTO/VP Eng managing enterprise IT operations, expanding security frameworks from SOC 2 to secondary standards like GDPR causes audit prep fatigue, consuming valuable engineering hours that should instead be spent scaling IT service platforms and supporting global office operations.
